questions.prompt: Which medieval trade alliance dominated northern European commerce?
questions.fact: It had no army, no capital and no constitution, yet at its height it could blockade entire kingdoms into submission.

questions.prompt: Which nutrient group provides the most energy per gram?
questions.fact: It carries more than twice the energy of the other two, which is why animals store reserves as fat rather than sugar.

questions.prompt: How many players from each side contest a game of beach volleyball?
questions.fact: There is no rotation and no positions, so both players must be able to do everything.

questions.prompt: Which country's cinema is known as Nollywood?
questions.fact: It produces more films per year than Hollywood, most shot in a matter of weeks and released straight to video.

questions.prompt: Which river forms much of the border between Brazil and Argentina?
questions.fact: It is South America's second-longest river, and its dams supply a large share of both countries' electricity.

questions.prompt: Which author wrote the novel Beloved's Pulitzer-winning contemporary, The Color Purple?
questions.fact: She coined the term womanist, arguing feminism as then framed did not describe her experience.

questions.prompt: Which company developed the PageRank algorithm?
questions.fact: It ranked pages by who linked to them, treating a link as a vote, which is why link-selling became an industry.
